title: Evaluate explicitly bounded obligation sets with the per-obligation contract
description:
Provide aggregate evaluation only for an explicitly bounded obligation set whose
membership has independent authority. Aggregate evaluation must use the same
obligation/discharge semantics as individual evaluation. This is a convenience/proof
mechanism for named bounded populations, not a universal closure engine.
acceptance_criteria:
- Aggregate evaluation is defined only for a named bounded population with independent membership authority.
- Aggregate and individual evaluation apply the same obligation/discharge contract.
- Missing, foreign, duplicated, or unresolved members fail the declared bounded claim rather than returning empty success.
- Passing an aggregate says only that the declared bounded obligations discharged; it proves neither corpus completeness nor absence of other mechanics.
